name: @pipeworx/mcp-usajobs

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search USAJOBS announcements. Returns title, agency, location, salary band, posting/closing dates.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a single announcement by USAJOBS announcement number.

tools.name: list_agencies
tools.description: Return the USAJOBS reference list of all federal agency sub-element codes and names; useful for resolving agency codes returned by the search tool.

tools.name: list_pay_grades
tools.description: Return the USAJOBS reference list of pay plan codes (GS, FW, ES, etc.) and their descriptions; use pay plan codes with the pay_grade_low/pay_grade_high search filters.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-usajobs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the usajobs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
